# ComfyDoctor

> ComfyDoctor is a free, privacy-first, 100% browser-based diagnostic tool for Stable Diffusion & ComfyUI workflows.

## Core Features
- **Offline Inspection**: Parses PNG tEXt/iTXt chunks and JSON graphs completely in-browser. Zero server transmission.
- **Dependency Extraction**: Identifies required Checkpoints, LoRAs, VAEs, and ControlNet files with their required target directories.
- **Node Diagnosis**: Separates native core ComfyUI nodes from third-party custom nodes with direct links to search GitHub repositories.
- **Privacy Sanitization**: Strips local OS absolute directories (e.g., `C:\Users\...` or `/home/...`) and accidental API key leaks before sharing.

## Ecosystem
Part of the VRAMSpec ecosystem (https://vramspec.com) for local AI workstation optimization and VRAM estimation.
